definitions.explanation: The complete disappearance of a species or type of organism.

examples.japanese: {恐竜|きょうりゅう}は6500{万年|まんねん}{前|まえ}に{絶滅|ぜつめつ}した。
examples.english: Dinosaurs went extinct 65 million years ago.

examples.japanese: この{動物|どうぶつ}は{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧種|きぐしゅ}だ。
examples.english: This animal is an endangered species.

examples.japanese: {絶滅|ぜつめつ}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{保護活動|ほごかつどう}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Conservation activities are being conducted to prevent extinction.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}する (to become extinct)
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}させる (to cause extinction)
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧種|きぐしゅ} (endangered species)
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}の{危機|きき} (danger of extinction)
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}に{瀕|ひん}する (to be on the brink of extinction)

RELATED TERMS:
・{希少種|きしょうしゅ} (rare species)
・{保護|ほご} (protection)
・{生態系|せいたいけい} (ecosystem)
・{生物多様性|せいぶつたようせい} (biodiversity)

COMPONENTS:
{絶|ぜつ} = to cut off, discontinue
{滅|めつ} = to destroy, perish
